name: Tinytanks.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Tinytanks.io is a free IOgame. The tank war is finally here and it is really tiny. Tinytanks.io is a fast, top-down shooter game that puts you in charge of your own tank. Your job is simple: stay alive, devastate the competition, and control the map. Sounds easy but it's not, this will require you to have a keen sense of aim to blast the competition with a huge collection of upgradeable weapons. You will also need to have lightning-fast reflexes in order to take potshots at your opponents and dodge any incoming blasts. There is no luck in this game. It is all tactical ability and strategic thinking. So, sharpen your trigger finger and get ready to blast your way through map after map of minimalistic little arenas filled with blood-thirsty enemies from around the world. This is an iogame which means that your opponents won't simply be robots programmed to hunt and destroy. In this game, other players from around the world will be locked in and sitting behind the controls of the little tanks. They'll have just as much skill, experience, and ambition as you and that is what will make them dangerous: The human element.
